# Implementation tests duplicated by the contrib suites

*Generated by `tools/contrib-duplicates.py` from the contrib repositories' `duplicates.json`; do not edit.*

The contrib suites ([rdf-tests-contrib](https://github.com/rdf-array/rdf-tests-contrib), [json-ld-api-contrib](https://github.com/rdf-array/json-ld-api-contrib), [shexTest-contrib](https://github.com/rdf-array/shexTest-contrib), [data-shapes-contrib](https://github.com/rdf-array/data-shapes-contrib)) collect tests that every rdf-array implementation can share but that no W3C suite contains. Each was seeded from an implementation's own tests, which stay where they are for now. This list says, implementation by implementation, which of its tests a contrib test reproduces, so that an implementation that walks the contrib manifests can retire or keep them knowingly.

| Suite | Contrib tests with a source |
|---|---|
| [rdf-tests-contrib](https://github.com/rdf-array/rdf-tests-contrib) | 39 |
| [json-ld-api-contrib](https://github.com/rdf-array/json-ld-api-contrib) | 60 |
| [shexTest-contrib](https://github.com/rdf-array/shexTest-contrib) | 20 |
| [data-shapes-contrib](https://github.com/rdf-array/data-shapes-contrib) | 5 |
